currently._note: Short list of what you're working on right now. Edit each month. 'updated' is the date shown to readers. 'items' are plain lines — keep them short.
items: Developing Design HOPES II with Sonja Dragojlovic-Oliveira, Laura MacLean and Parastoo Sali — a home–health environment assessment toolkit to support healthcare practitioners, with workshops and design experiences to come. A new intern is joining the toolkit work soon.
Serving as the Department of Architecture's EDI representative to the faculty, and chairing EDI for the department.
Academic lead for the ASHRAE Strathclyde Student Branch, mentoring postgraduate researchers and growing the student network.
Committee member of the Research, Knowledge Exchange and Innovation Culture Network (RKEI) at Strathclyde, with activities planned around welcome week.
Teaching design modes and regenerative design, and developing a building energy simulation course for architecture students.

news._note: Add updates here — newest first. Each item has date, type, and text. 'type' is a short label, e.g. Paper, Talk, Teaching, Service, Conference, Appointment, Award.
news.text: Co-hosted the UKIEG conference at Strathclyde with Alejandro Moreno-Rangel — around 40 participants shared research on indoor environmental quality and energy retrofit across the UK, including a team from Sweden.
Wrapped up an academic writing workshop for architecture PhD students — four sessions on writing conference papers.
Became academic lead of the ASHRAE Strathclyde Student Branch. An interim postgraduate board was elected: Praveen (President), Stephanie (Vice-President), and Temi (Secretary).
Took on the role of EDI representative for the Department of Architecture at faculty level, and chair of EDI for the department.
Appointed committee member of the Research, Knowledge Exchange and Innovation Culture Network (RKEI) at the University of Strathclyde.
Appointed Strathclyde Chancellor's Fellow at the University of Strathclyde, Glasgow.
Paper accepted at CLIMA 2025: 'Hygrothermal Risks from Vapor-Impermeable Insulation in Existing Housing.'
Received Associate Fellowship in Teaching and Learning in Higher Education (UK).
